dedupe_keys.name: dataset for operational dynamic performance of an aging reinforced concrete bridge under increased heavy traffic demand

description: Bolívar Maza and colleagues publish monitoring data from the ageing Pindo River reinforced-concrete bridge in Ecuador under heavy vehicle traffic. Zenodo provides an open ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The described package holds MiniSEED acceleration for 217 independent vehicle events, processed displacement signals, Python processing scripts and plots of frequencies and dynamic envelopes. It can support calibration of bridge response or structural-health-monitoring methods under changed traffic demand. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this bridge or its event measurements. The page does not state the exact observation dates, sensor layout or sampling rate, and the processed displacement depends on baseline correction and double integration. A single bridge may not represent other deck or foundation types. No archive was downloaded, and the 217-event count, frequencies and displacements were not independently reproduced.
